title: We Actually Fixed The Ozone Hole. 99% Of The Cause Is Gone.
hook: 99% of the chemicals eating your sky are already gone.
closing: The world agreed, and the sky is healing.
question: What should we fix next?

segments.say: The hole shrank from 29.9 million square kilometers in 2000 to 22.9 in 2025.
99% of the chemicals that tore it open have now been phased out.
The rest of the world heals in 14 years; Antarctica takes 40.
